summary: A stat card that leans up to 10 degrees toward the pointer in 3D and settles flat on leave, driven by a Spring.
use: Feature cards, pricing tiers or stat tiles on desktop where hover should add depth.
spec: `const MAX = 10;` degrees of rotation at the card edge
`new Spring({ x: 0, y: 0 }, { stiffness: 0.1, damping: 0.6 })` drives `rotateX` and `rotateY`
`@media (pointer: coarse)` sets `transform: none`: no tilt on touch
Under reduced motion `--rx` and `--ry` stay at 0
